title: Gateway rollback floors share the rollback domain with protected state
description: Security review finding: lichend places gateway-trust.bin and gateway-trust.generation together under state_root, and likewise gateway-slot-replay.bin with gateway-slot-replay.generation. The code/documentation calls each floor independent/monotonic, but both are ordinary atomically-renamed files in the same directory. Restoring one filesystem snapshot rolls back the sealed record and its minimum together, so TrustStore::load and SlotClaimVerifier::load accept the old valid signature/generation. This can resurrect removed/rotated gateway trust and permit previously consumed slot claims after reboot. Store floors in a genuinely non-rollbackable authority (TPM/NV counter, platform monotonic storage, or an append-only externally anchored log), or explicitly fail deployment when unavailable; test rollback of both paired files, not only one side.
